item.tib: dbal che mchog mngon du rol pa'i dbang drag zlog pa'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: gsang ba zlog mdos kyi gyer gzhung*/ byad ma stong 'joms zhes bya ba/ u rgyan gyis (gyi) mkhan po nam mkha' gsal grub dang / rgya gar gyis (gyi) mkhan po lha bdag sngags grol dang / za hor gyis (gyi) mkhan po don yod snying po dang gsum gyis/ stag gzig kyi yul/ byang sham b+ha la'i gnas mchog nas/ u rgyan dang rgya gar za hor gsum gyis (gyi) yul du/ g.yung drung lha'i skad las/ rang rang gi skad du bsgyur ba'o/ gshen po de gsum la/ khod spungs dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) zhus nas/ zhang zhung dang bod du bsgyar te 'phel ba lags so//
